package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
)

func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil
	} else if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return errors.New("request body must contain a single JSON value")
}
